resources.string: Block embedded ads
Loads live streams without ads through a third-party proxy, which sees your IP address and the channels you watch.
Block video ads
Blocks the ads Twitch requests itself, but ads inside live streams need Block embedded ads.
Ignore ad events
Ignores the ad breaks and ad tracking Twitch announces during a stream.
Reseam settings entry
Adds Reseam Settings above Account in Twitch\'s settings.
Enable debug mode
Shows Twitch\'s staff tools, such as the debug menu and the video debug panel.
Fix login crash
Stops Twitch from crashing right after you log in.
Startup tab
Opens Twitch on Browse or Profile, and unlocks the Default Home Page setting.
Hide create button
Hides the Create button in the bottom bar and the side rail.
Hide stories shelf
Hides the row of stories at the top of Home.
Block analytics
Stops comScore, Nielsen, Sentry, Crashlytics, Sprig and Branch.
Disable update prompts
Stops update prompts.
Auto-claim rewards
Claims bonus Channel Points in the background as you watch.
Clean share links
Removes tracking from the links you share and copy.
Default video quality
Starts streams and videos in the quality you choose, Source by default.
Refresh stream
Reloads a stuck stream the way Twitch\'s Retry button does.
Show VOD chapters
Adds a Chapters button to the VOD player that lists the stream\'s category changes and jumps to the one you pick.
Hide subscription upsells
Hides the Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the Turbo offers.
Hide player overlay buttons
Hides the clip, cast, share and rotate screen buttons on the player.
Hide leaderboards
Hides the gifter, cheerer and clip leaderboards above chat.
Hide bits buttons
Hides the Bits button next to the chat field and the Cheer button in landscape chat.
Hide channel points buttons
Hides the Channel Points button next to the chat field and in landscape chat.
Hide community highlights
Hides pinned messages, hype trains, polls, predictions and the other highlights above chat.
Hide chat badges
Hides the badges next to names in chat.
Hide welcome message
Hides the Welcome to the chat room line that chat shows when it connects.
Keep deleted messages
Shows the text of messages that moderators remove, on a red background and labeled Deleted, Timeout or Banned.
Keep chat after a clear
Keeps the messages in chat when a moderator clears it, without Twitch\'s Chat was cleared by a moderator line.
Hide blocked messages
In channels you moderate, removes the placeholder Twitch shows for a blocked user\'s message.
Shrink giant emotes
Shows emotes gigantified with Bits at normal size.
Hide sub and gift notices
Hides the chat lines for subs, resubs and gift subs.
Hide shared chat from other channels
In a shared chat, hides the messages and notices from the other channels.
Hide watch streaks
Hides watch streaks in chat, the Channel Points menu, the Following tab, Home and channel pages.
Don\'t follow raids
Keeps you in the channel when it raids another channel.
Hide viewer count
Hides the number of viewers on the player.
Hide content classification label
Hides labels such as Intended for certain audiences at the top of the player.
Skip mature content warnings
Starts streams and videos labeled for mature audiences without the warning screen.
